name: Honored Amongst the Clan
label: Quest
description: Honored Amongst the Clan: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: It is good to see you again, adventurer. I had not expected you to return. Alas, you have proven yourself a brave and honorable soldier of the Frostwolf.
Your time has come again, friend. You have earned a new ranking and as such, a new insignia denoting this rise in stature.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Go, friend! Continue your defense of the Frostwolf. This war must be won! For Drek'Thar! For the Warchief!
